name: inline-edit
title: Inline edit
description: Text that becomes a field on click. Enter saves, Escape cancels.
htmlExample:
<bef-inline-edit id="ie" value="Click to rename me" style="width:260px"></bef-inline-edit>
<script>const ie = document.getElementById('ie'); ie.props = { onSave: (v) => ie.setAttribute('value', v) };</script>
